サイトについて本文1: Nurie Maker is a free web service that converts your images into coloring books with a single click. It can be used for various purposes such as children's education, adult relaxation, and gift message cards.
特徴1本文: Just upload an image and press a button. No specialized image editing knowledge is required. It can also be used from smartphones.
特徴2本文: Created coloring books can be digitally colored directly in your browser. You can freely change colors and line thickness, and start over as many times as you like.
特徴3本文: Completed coloring books can be downloaded as images and easily shared on Twitter or Facebook. Enjoy your creations with family and friends.
活用シーン本文: It can be used in a wide range of situations, such as educational activities at home, indoor play on rainy days, recreation at day-care services, and creating original coloring books from photos of pets and family.
